Compassion
Has No Borders

Help that arrives in person — for the people and animals the world overlooks.

Rising Light UK is a grassroots charity born in London, running hands-on humanitarian and animal-welfare projects across the UK, the United States and Guatemala — and growing wherever the need leads.
